title: Loot Shelf
description: Lean 5e-only loot containers and merchant shelf. A chest is an actor on the scene: players loot it through a dnd5e-native container sheet built from the system's own inventory components, taking items and coin with a Take button — into their character or their party's stash — without the GM granting ownership, and drags out default to move instead of copy. Merchants get the same sheet as a shop: browsable stock with prices, a buy flow that checks coin and hands the item over GM-side, selling back at a configurable rate, and a per-item hide-from-shelf flag. Native ApplicationV2 UI, plain game.socket GM proxy, no dependencies.
